FndZlda.exe  —  Windows one-click hunter

Download the built EXE from GitHub Releases:
https://github.com/Memberoffoxhound/FndZlda/releases/latest/download/FndZlda.exe

Double-click it. First run downloads a portable Python into
%LOCALAPPDATA%\FndZlda\python (no admin, no PATH). Then the cave
opens, the old man gives you the Master Sword, and the scan starts.

US stores only. Type 1 / 2 / 3 for console, Pro Controller, or both.

Rebuild from Linux:
  ./build-windows.sh
